Reference image1 is the current new Pha Giap character key-pose board; use it for exact character identity, head/clothing proportions and physical wooden staff, do not alter that file. Reference image2 is approved Cai Bang identity/style only.
Draw EXACTLY 24 distinct full-body sprites on genuinely transparent alpha: SIX columns by FOUR rows, generous gutters. Rows RIGHT, DOWN/FRONT, LEFT, UP/BACK. Within each row the hero faces that SAME direction in all six cels. Keep planted feet at consistent baseline, same costume/head/body size, same world position. This is an actual hand-and-staff TWIRL, not just a magic ring around a motionless hero.
Six sequential poses in each row: 1 staff horizontal across waist held at its center; 2 two hands/regrip turn the staff to rising diagonal across chest; 3 staff vertical in front of torso with upper/lower end clearly separated; 4 continue turning to opposite diagonal while elbows/wrists articulate; 5 horizontal with the grip and hands now completing the rotation; 6 final diagonal leading smoothly back into frame1. The physical wooden staff changes orientation through a near full rotation around the grip. Draw real different arm/wrist/elbow poses. Do NOT rotate the whole character, do NOT spin the image canvas, do NOT duplicate one static pose, no extra arms, no growing weapon in this phase, no attack lunge. Both feet stay planted. The character may turn shoulders subtly but never turns away from the row's facing; UP row shows ponytail/red back throughout, no face.
Identity: black ponytail and red ribbon, red layered wuxia tunic with cream collar/wrist wraps, dark brown trousers and shoes, young chibi martial hero, expressive brow. One plain dark wooden staff, no spearhead, sword or metal weapon. Warm upper-left highlights, crisp clustered pixel edges, limited matching palette, Pokemon-like elevated 3/4 orthographic RPG perspective, not isometric or side-view. Small compact body around130 source pixels tall; normal staff around160px long. Leave wide transparent cell margins so every rotating staff tip and every head is fully visible, no neighboring sprites touching.
Character and staff only. No shadows, VFX arcs, ground, text, labels, borders, smoke, brown background, vignette, watermark or checkerboard. Transparent alpha outside sprites. This is authored draft animation cels to improve the requested physical spin, not a production gameplay change.
